per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to parts searches within 15 seconds to prevent user frustration.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to repair facility searches within 10 seconds to support field operations.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for the preferred repair facility shall take no longer than 8 seconds. The preferred repair facility is returned within 8 seconds'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should comply with corporate architecture and UI guidelines to ensure consistency and smooth deployments.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be easy to use, requiring minimal training (2 days max) for adjusters and estimators.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should allow adjusters to see which parts in an estimate came from recycled sources and provide visibility into parts usage trends.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall interface with the Choice Parts System. This provides the feed of recycled parts data.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should implement role-based access control to prevent data leaks and ensure appropriate permissions.
The system should be highly available, with downtime limited to ensure business continuity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall achieve a 98% uptime. The product shall not fail more than 2% of the available online time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should have protections against denial-of-service (DoS) attacks, including rate-limiting and CDN/WAF patterns.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall prevent malicious attacks including denial of service.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support a large number of concurrent users (low thousands) without performance degradation.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be able to handle up to 1500 simultaneous users. The system shall perform with 1500 users as a time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should work on standard corporate browsers and tablets, with graceful degradation on flaky mobile networks.
The system should maintain audit trails for parts sourcing decisions and provide reporting capabilities for managers.
The system should implement fuzzy matching for vehicle codes and shop names to improve search usability.
